name: Yuubana Mayuki
source:
Role: Liar
Role in the Coμ: Priest

The youngest among the five people who controls Babylon. As you can see, she is a loli and her glasses signifies that she is an otaku. She is living alone away from her parents. She often lies to trick people. She doesn't seem to like it when people call her "Mayu-Mayu."
